one_level_composition_registry.semantic_rule: C is colorable iff some proper boundary color of the cut vertex makes every component colorable under exact boundary-deleted lists.

composition_V1_closure_rule.rule: A composition candidate is ROUTABLE in V1 only if, for every proper boundary assignment that survives exact propagation and every resulting connected child component, the child is immediately recognized by a direct terminal T0-T7. Nested C1/C2/C3 recursion is forbidden in V1.
composition_V1_closure_rule.reason: Prevents hidden exponential branching across separator depth while preserving the already sealed one-level composition theorems.
composition_V1_closure_rule.recognizer: Enumerate all vertex separators of size 1,2,3 in polynomial time, all <=4^|S| boundary states, exact propagated child components, and direct-terminal predicates. Choose the first fully closed candidate under frozen ordering.
composition_V1_closure_rule.reconstruction: For a successful boundary assignment, union direct-terminal child reconstructions with the boundary coloring; UNSAT iff every boundary assignment has at least one directly certified UNSAT child.
composition_V1_closure_rule.complexity_bound: O(n^3 * 64 * n * P_direct(n)) plus direct graph checks; polynomial. No recursive composition factor is permitted.

explicitly_not_router_terminals: bounded semantic PI mask count <=16 alone

soundness_obligations.terminal_soundness: If router emits T_i, the exact predicate and bound authority must verify and the emitted SAT/UNSAT answer must be exactly equivalent to list-colorability of the routed component.
soundness_obligations.transformation_soundness: Every list/graph transformation must preserve extension semantics in both directions and carry a reconstruction map.
soundness_obligations.composition_soundness: C1-C3 may emit only with a verified separator certificate and V1 one-level closure; exact factorization equivalence plus child terminal correctness gives exact parent correctness.
soundness_obligations.PI_bit_soundness: For a fixed (gamma,delta), if every residual component is routed and solved, q_gamma_delta equals the conjunction of exact component satisfiability; if any component is UNROUTED, the router must not guess the bit.
soundness_obligations.no_oracle: No extension oracle or hidden known coloring may participate in routing, terminal selection, separator selection, or transformations.

completeness_candidate.name: C11_TERMINAL_ROUTER_COMPLETENESS_CANDIDATE
completeness_candidate.statement: For every legal residual generated by the frozen C11/PI pair-fixed construction, at least one recognized source-backed direct terminal or V1 one-level composition certificate applies after polynomially computable graph/list transformations preserving extension semantics and reconstruction.
completeness_candidate.implication_if_eventually_proved: All four Pi bits could be discovered polynomially by routing, potentially bypassing the need to establish P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT as an algorithmic bottleneck.
completeness_candidate.nonimplication_now: P3 bypass is NOT established by this formalization.
